name: flowlever
description: Local review cockpit for specs and PR review/respond: a fingerprinted findings ledger that tracks issues across rounds, a guided review-flow stepper, exportable work orders, and UI-triggered jobs. Bundles the zero-dependency Node app plus /flowlever:* skills (audit, propose, apply-spec, rework, brief, track, start, stop, watch, poll, pr-review, pr-respond).
